_comment: Laptop overfit sanity run 2 of 3 (scripts/run_overfit_tests.cmd): the real 0.6B student on ~10 s of train audio (seeded subset of the kept reazon_small/emilia_yodas/galgame train rows; the ids are the `subset` events) for 100 epochs = 100 optimizer steps (step_audio_s >= the subset: one step per epoch), an eval after every epoch on ~10 s of the pooled gate eval sets (teacher-forced + greedy) and a probe on the whole train subset (teacher-forced + greedy on up to 10 s of it). Expect the probe KL and CER vs teacher to fall towards 0. Viability settings otherwise, SpecAugment off, warmup 10 steps (10 %), cooldown over the last 20 %, AdamW + fp32 masters offloaded to host memory (see overfit_1s.json for the measured CPU cost, ~2.5-3.5 s per step). Expected wall time: 100 x ~3-4 s steps (~6 min) + 100 evals x ~3-4 s (~6 min) + setup, smoke and the full states (8.6 GB each) after the smoke steps and every 10 min of loop time, the resume points scripts/supervise_distill.py relaunches from after a GPU fault (~6 min) = about 15-25 min.
